brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road. In Chapters 8 and 9, the outlaws hide the boys in a hut in the forest. Find a spot where a hut could hide, then take a photo.
mapday: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read each line from the book and tap who said it. Then finish two sentences about the hideout.
extra: Find a spot that would be a bad hideout. Say why the outlaws would not hide there.
step1: You won’t build today. You will find a good hiding spot. Read the four things to look for. This list is also in VR, in the Canvas tab.
step2: Put on your headset and open the On-Demand app. Click Explore, type today’s map in Filter environments, and click it. Then click Begin Solo.
step3: Walk and teleport through the forest. Find a spot with trees close together, far from the path, in deep shade.
step4: Stand in your spot and say this out loud. This is a good hideout because… The king’s soldiers would not find it because…
step5: Stand back so it all fits. Open your menu: Library, then Camera, then Take photo. Click the Canvas tab, pick this week’s VR assignment, and click Choose from My Files. Pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag. Then press the Meta button and click Quit.
